definition: Answers only. The questions and options are the application's own questionnaire (GET /api/questionnaire, read from datasets/raw/FAR-Trans/questionnaires.csv) and are never copied here. The questionnaire is the research instrument's own wording (its money bands are stated in euros); these answers use the approximate real-world equivalent of each persona's rupee figures. The application stores the answers but no analysis step reads them.
answers_basis: Curated to match the profile: 32, married, salaried, new to investing. Only the first three sections (demographics, knowledge and experience, financial independence) are answered; the risk-tolerance and objectives sections (questions 16 to 25) are intentionally left unanswered, which is part of why more information is needed.
